svg.title: Service dependencies
svg.desc: Service dependencies: dag-vertical diagram, 9 nodes, 11 edges. DAG · service dependencies. Flow: web → API gateway; API gateway → Auth; API gateway → Orders; API gateway → Search; Auth → Postgres (reads); Orders → Postgres; …. Full data in hw:payload.

hw:zone.reason: var() does not resolve in an SVG presentation attribute, so this paint is decided at compose time
licensed brand colour, independent of the genome

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: Topology graph on a transparent ground — nodes as 1px cards (rx12, hero rx14 at 1.5px in the signal accent), flow carried by dashed connectors and the closed motion grammar; reads as the same hand that drew the badges and the matrix, not a generic graphviz dump.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: Every layout is a closed-form solve from chassis constants: the pipeline distributes card widths over a 896px banner with 60px gaps; fans share midpoint S-curves (control points at the chord's x midpoint); the flywheel trims its 178px arcs by each card's angular half-width plus 1.2 degrees (the specimen's 24-degree inset at any ring count). Connectors run a marching 5-7 dash (1.618s) with particle riders — compositor-only properties; geometry never moves. Radial spokes draw under the hub card so they emanate from its surface.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: Direction is carried by motion, never arrowheads — a reduced-motion or rasterized embed falls back to dashed tubes and reading order alone. Beam/flow repaint per frame, so they declare performance=paint-ok and degrade to particle/dash on composite-only surfaces; dark papers run brighter 400-level flow hues, trading cross-variant hue identity for legible strokes on near-black grounds. Transformed artifact: 1 field edit; insertion seat none — structure-preserving edit. Survivor rows ride the parent's pinned rank order (layout.rank_orders, inside the hashed payload) and single-source sinks snap to their source's row, so the lanes the parent composed stay straight; a chip edge that must bend hands its label off the wire to a micro-label beside it, so the thread keeps the one bow its siblings draw. The fresh crossing minimum is spent for figure continuity: the reader's held map outranks the sweep.
